components.css: .ds-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;min-width:0;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);border-radius:12px;padding:4px;background:#fbfaf5;box-shadow:0 3px 15px #142b2526;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#7d8b7d #fbfaf5;animation:ds-unfold 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-menu a,.ds-menu button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;border:0;color:#263d33;background:#fbfaf5;font:600 15px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:manipulation;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu svg{width:19px;height:19px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-menu a:hover,.ds-menu button:hover{background:#e5eadd}.ds-menu a:active,.ds-menu button:active{background:#d4dfcd}.ds-menu a:focus-visible,.ds-menu button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #263d33;outline-offset:-4px}@keyframes ds-unfold{from{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 12%)}to{clip-path:inset(0)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-menu{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, dark green type, generous breathing room, and prominent weather numbers make lazy easy to read at a glance and comfortable to operate by touch. The dashboard is quiet and flat; the compact launcher floats above ordinary webpages.

Use simple geometric SVG icons rather than imagery. The approved palette and restrained composition define the visual identity; the launcher uses native system type to fit its host pages.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral paper with dark green text.
Large touch targets and a clear numerical hierarchy.
Flat dashboard, compact floating launcher, Polish interface copy.
dos: Do keep weather readable and destination links usable during network failures.
Do use the shared destination list and its Polish descriptions.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do use self-hosted Atkinson on the dashboard and system-ui inside the launcher.
donts: Don't introduce images, decorative cards, or extra destination links without a real product need.
Don't add a lock control: this extension cannot lock Android.
Don't present fullscreen when the current document does not support it.
Don't let launcher styling leak into the host webpage.
